title: 第1章 重生洪荒我选择三第2章 五方宝旗良心系统
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
滴！
洪荒快递已送达，恭喜您签收盘古正宗——祖巫帝江大礼包，附赠鸿蒙量天尺一把，请给五星好评哦，亲！
随着一阵电子音话语，帝江的意识像是被塞进了一台高速离心机，天旋地转之后，猛地被摁进了一个坚实的容器里。
不知过了多久，百万年，还是一亿年！
帝江缓缓睁开双眼，首先看到的不是天花板，而是一片浩瀚无垠、道纹密布的穹顶，散发着苍茫古老的气息。
“我这是，在哪儿？”
帝江想抬手揉揉眼睛，却发现自己的手臂沉重无比，皮肤呈现出一种健康的古铜色，上面还爬满了银灰色、不断流转的玄奥纹路，稍微一动，周围的空间就泛起细微的涟漪。
低头一看，好家伙，这身板儿，这肌肉线条，去参加全球先生选美大赛都能稳拿冠军！
再环顾四周，此时他正躺在一个巨大无比的神殿中央，神殿的柱子粗得堪比行星轨道，空气中弥漫着令人心悸的力量感。
而在他身边，整齐地排列着十一颗巨蛋！
这些蛋颜色各异，赤红、浊黄、蔚蓝……每一颗都蕴含着磅礴的能量和独特的法则气息，像心跳一样，有节奏地起伏着，仿佛在沉睡。
“蛋？神殿？肌肉猛男身？等等，我枕头边这把尺子怎么在冒紫气？还感觉能一尺子量断星河？”
帝江脑子里一团浆糊，作为网络小说爱好者的记忆开始翻涌。
这配置，这场景！
“我去！
我不会是穿越到洪荒，还成了那个空间速度之祖巫，十二祖巫的老大——帝江了吧？”
就在他试图消化这个惊天事实，并为自己未来“不修元神，只练肉体，最后大概率在巫妖大战里扑街”
的命运感到一丝蛋疼时，一个毫无感情的电子音在他脑海响起：
叮！
检测到宿主灵魂与祖巫帝江本源融合完毕。

神级选择系统正式激活！
绑定成功！
“系统？”
帝江精神一振，网文诚不我欺！
穿越者标配果然虽迟但到！
新手大礼包已发放，请宿主注意查看，现发布初始选择任务，请宿主在以下三项中做出抉择：
帝江眼前光幕展开，三个选项清晰浮现：
选项一：放弃祖巫血脉，奖励完整的元神。
看到这个，帝江心里的小算盘噼里啪啦响了起来：“放弃祖巫血脉？那就是不做蛮子了？祖巫肉身强是强，但没有元神，不能感悟天道，不能使用法宝，跟个超级兵似的。
要是有了完整元神，凭借我对洪荒剧情的了解，加上系统辅助，拜入玄门或者找个地方偷偷发育，说不定真能避开大劫，逍遥自在，毕竟，活着才有输出啊！
而且三清那边福利好像也不错？
选项二：舍弃部分本源帮助其他祖巫快速出世，奖励巫族诞生元神的修炼之法。
“这个选项……”
帝江摸了摸下巴，目光扫过那十一颗巨蛋，“有点意思。
牺牲我一部分，加速弟弟妹妹们出世。
奖励是让整个巫族都能修炼出元神？卧槽，这要是成了，十二个有元神的祖巫，还能布都天神煞大阵召唤盘古真身！
那画面太美不敢看！
洪荒横着走啊！
这是要走集体致富、共同富裕路线？听起来很有搞头，就是前期投入大了点，而且怎么带领一帮肌肉棒子修炼元神也是个技术活……
选项三：吞噬其他祖巫本源，奖励先天至宝混沌钟、与肉身完美契合的元神，并完整掌控其余祖巫的法则大道。

（注：吞噬后宿主将进入重新孕育阶段，不过不会失去意识）
“嘶——！”
帝江倒吸一口凉气，感觉盘古神殿的空气质量都上升了零点几个百分点。
“吞噬所有弟弟妹妹的本源？！
content_en:
drop!
Honghuang Express has been delivered. Congratulations on signing for the authentic Pangu-Zuwu Dijiang gift package, which comes with a Hongmeng measuring ruler. Please give it a five-star rating, dear!
Following a burst of electronic voice words, Di Jiang's consciousness seemed to be stuffed into a high-speed centrifuge. After the world was spinning, he was suddenly pressed into a solid container.
I don’t know how long has passed, a million years, or a hundred million years!
Di Jiang slowly opened his eyes, and the first thing he saw was not the ceiling, but a vast and densely covered dome, exuding a vast and ancient atmosphere.
"Where am I?"
Di Jiang wanted to raise his hand to rub his eyes, but found that his arm was extremely heavy, and his skin showed a healthy bronze color. It was also covered with silver-gray, mysterious lines that were constantly flowing. If he moved slightly, subtle ripples would appear in the surrounding space.
I lowered my head and saw, my dear, with this body and these muscular lines, I can definitely win the championship in the Mr. Global beauty pageant!
Looking around again, he was lying in the center of a huge temple. The pillars of the temple were as thick as planetary orbits, and the air was filled with a heart-stopping sense of power.
And beside him, there were eleven giant eggs neatly arranged!
These eggs are of different colors, red, turbid yellow, blue... Each one contains majestic energy and a unique atmosphere of law. Like a heartbeat, it rises and falls rhythmically, as if it is sleeping.
"Egg? Temple? Muscular body? Wait, why is this ruler next to my pillow emitting purple gas? Does it still feel like it can measure the galaxy with one ruler?"
Dijiang's mind was in a state of confusion, and his memories of being a lover of online novels began to surge.
This configuration, this scene!
"I'll go!
Could it be that I traveled to the prehistoric times and became the ancestral witch of space speed, the boss of the twelve ancestral witches - Di Jiang? "
Just as he was trying to digest this shocking fact, and prepare for his future, "If you don't cultivate your soul, you only train your body, you will most likely end up on the street in a lich war."
When his destiny felt a little painful, an emotionless electronic sound sounded in his mind:
Ding!
It is detected that the host soul has been fused with the Ancestor Witch Emperor Jiang Benyuan.
The god-level selection system is officially activated!
Binding successful!
"System?"
Di Jiang perked up and said, "Wang Wen is sincere and will not bully me!"
The standard equipment for time travelers has indeed arrived late!
The novice gift package has been distributed. Hosts are requested to check it carefully. The initial selection task is now released. Hosts are asked to make a choice among the following three items:
The curtain of light unfolded before Di Jiang's eyes, and three options emerged clearly:
Option 1: Give up the ancestral witch bloodline and be rewarded with a complete soul.
Seeing this, the abacus in Di Jiang's heart began to crackle: "Giving up the bloodline of the ancestral witch? Does that mean that you don't want to be a barbarian? The ancestral witch is physically strong, but he has no soul, cannot understand the way of heaven, and cannot use magic weapons. He is like a super soldier."
If I have a complete soul, relying on my understanding of the prehistoric plot, plus system assistance, worshiping the Xuanmen or finding a place to develop secretly, I might be able to avoid the catastrophe and be at ease. After all, only output can be achieved when you are alive!
And the benefits at Sanqing seem to be pretty good too?
Option 2: Give up part of the origin to help other ancestral witches be born quickly, and reward the witch clan with the cultivation method to give birth to the soul.
"This option..."
Di Jiang touched his chin and glanced at the eleven giant eggs, "It's interesting.
Sacrifice a part of me to hasten the birth of my younger brothers and sisters.
The reward is to allow the entire witch clan to cultivate the soul? Damn it, if this were to happen, twelve ancestral witches with souls would be able to summon Pangu's true form through the formation of the Gods and Evils!
That picture is too beautiful to look at!
Honghuang is walking sideways!
Is this a path to collective wealth and common prosperity? It sounds promising, but the initial investment is a bit high, and how to lead a group of muscle sticks to cultivate the soul is also a technical job...
Option three: Devour the origins of other ancestral witches, reward the innate treasure Chaos Bell, the soul that perfectly fits the physical body, andCompletely control the laws and avenues of other ancestral witches.
(Note: After swallowing, the host will enter the re-gestation stage, but will not lose consciousness)
"Hiss——!"
Di Jiang took a breath and felt that the air quality in Pangu Temple had increased by a few tenths of a percentage point.
"The origin that swallows all the younger brothers and sisters?!
